The infected wounds are said to have been progressing for 3 months at admission on October 23, 2017, while the fall that started the course is dated July 2016 and the angiography and 2nd-toe amputation are dated only September without a year.

The discussion sentence listing arteriosclerotic stenosis, prolonged wound infection and multiple organ dysfunction as risk factors is not explicitly stated as findings of this patient.
The abstract names atherosclerosis and the text separately names arteriosclerotic stenosis and vascular occlusion of the lower extremities; the source does not state how these relate or their sides.
